mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torrent_native_metadata (info_hash,torrent_bencode,metainfo_sha256,piece_length,piece_count,total_bytes,created_at) VALUES (#{metadata.infoHash},#{metadata.torrentBencode,jdbcType=BLOB,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ByteArrayTypeHandler}, #{metadata.metainfoSha256},#{metadata.pieceLength}, #{metadata.pieceCount},#{metadata.totalBytes},#{metadata.createdAt}) ON CONFLICT(info_hash) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO torrent_native_metadata (info_hash,torrent_bencode,metainfo_sha256,piece_length,piece_count,total_bytes,created_at) VALUES (#{metadata.infoHash},#{metadata.torrentBencode,jdbcType=BLOB,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ByteArrayTypeHandler}, #{metadata.metainfoSha256},#{metadata.pieceLength}, #{metadata.pieceCount},#{metadata.totalBytes},#{metadata.createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE info_hash=info_hash
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM torrent_native_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('CREATED','READY','RUNNING','PAUSED')
SELECT * FROM torrent_native_task WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE torrent_native_task SET status = #{newStatus}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE torrent_native_task SET status='RUNNING', revision=revision+1, execution_epoch=execution_epoch+1, execution_instance_id=#{instanceId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_uuid=#{taskUuid} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND status='READY' AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND #{instanceId} IS NOT NULL

UPDATE torrent_native_task SET verified_selected_bytes = #{verifiedSelectedBytes}, status = #{newStatus}, revision = revision + 1, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'COMPLETED' THEN COALESCE(completed_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND status IN ('CREATED','READY','PAUSED','FAILED','COMPLETED') AND (verified_selected_bytes <> #{verifiedSelectedBytes} OR status <> #{newStatus}) AND selected_total_bytes >= #{verifiedSelectedBytes}

UPDATE torrent_native_task SET deleted = id, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND status IN ('CREATED','READY','PAUSED','FAILED','COMPLETED')
